key_facts: The Army published a sources-sought notice for the Next Generation Counter-sUAS Missile (NGCM), seeking a munition costing less than $150,000 per round in a quantity buy of at least 5,000 missiles.
The NGCM must achieve TRL 7 by end of Q4 FY2027, target Group 2 and Group 3 UAS, defeat drones at ranges greater than 16km (threshold) or 25+km (objective).
The weapon must be compatible with the Coyote missile launcher and the Integrated Battle Command System Maneuver (IBCS-M).
The Army awarded a $5 billion contract to Raytheon last year for its Coyote missile system and associated technologies.
The Army also picked Anduril to provide its AI-powered Lattice software platform for the IBCS-M program; industry responses to the NGCM notice are due Aug. 20.
